async def act(page):
    # Click the Customers link in the menubar to open its dropdown menu
    customers_link = page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name=' Customers')
    await customers_link.click()
    # Wait briefly for the menu to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'All Customers' link in the menu to navigate to the customer list page
    all_customers_link = page.get_by_role('menu').get_by_role('link', name='All Customers')
    await all_customers_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')  # Wait for the new page to load
    pass
